استقبحت (form X)
# اِسْتَقْبَحْتُ (istaqbaḥtu) /is.taq.baħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
# اِسْتَقْبَحْتَ (istaqbaḥta) /is.taq.baħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
# اِسْتَقْبَحْتِ (istaqbaḥti) /is.taq.baħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
# اِسْتَقْبَحَتْ (istaqbaḥat) /is.t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
